With over 40 years of experience in holistic health, Bea shares her transformative journey into the world of plant-based diets and alternative healing methods. From her personal story of seeking unconventional treatments for her mother’s cancer to becoming a respected educator and author, Bea's insights uncover the powerful benefits of plant medicine.

Explore the vital role that polyphenols, flavonoids, and isophenols play in preventing and reversing diseases. Discover how a whole food, plant-based diet can dramatically impact your health, wellness, and longevity. Tune in to hear inspiring discussions on how you can incorporate these healing practices into your lifestyle starting today.
